chunks.notes: Neither candidate is usable as-is. The final text was built from the full Arabic source, with all names, dates (6/5/1425 AH; 24/6/2004 AD), numbering, and genealogical relationships preserved. The source contains no [[...]] location markers, so none are included. Some transliterations (e.g., 'Ar'ma' al-Thajjah', 'Al Buraid') are best-effort and should be checked by a native specialist for standard spelling of tribal and place names.
